capabilities: Import highlights and annotations from Kobo
Import highlights and annotations from Apple Books
Reconcile the same book across reading sources by ISBN or title
Create one standardized note per book, grouped by chapter
Trigger extraction via sidebar icon or command
extras: The Kobo extractor requires pointing the plugin to the KoboReader.sqlite database on the device; the Apple Books extractor only works on macOS.
intentEvidence: Why would I use this instead of kobo-highlights-importer / apple-books-highlights-plugin etc.?
motivation: The author forked an existing Kobo importer because they wanted Kobo support and liked how its output notes grouped annotations by chapter.
problem: Highlights made in different reading services end up scattered in different formats and separate notes, even when they come from the same book.

relations.evidence: I built this plugin by forking obsidian-kobo-highlights-import
I also looked at the code for obsidian-apple-books-highlight-plugin to build the Apple Books plugin

requires.name: Kobo e-reader (KoboReader.sqlite file) or Apple Books on macOS

summary: Imports highlights and annotations from Kobo and Apple Books into Obsidian, reconciling the same book across sources into one standardized note per book.
